pilot_launch: Squadron, form up. We punch through their screen and make for the trench!
All wings report in. This is the run that counts!
Here we go again. Stay sharp — the station remembers us now.
pilot_fighters: Here they come. Watch the crossfire!
pilot_hit: Shields took one — hold together, baby!
That was too close. Shields are thinning!
pilot_surface: Down on the deck. Cannon towers ahead — strafe and keep moving!
Surface run! Watch the tower fire!
pilot_trench: I'm in the trench. Walls are tight — stay with me!
Into the trench! Thread the barriers, steady hands!
pilot_almost: Port's coming up. Hold this line...
pilot_victory: It's a hit! The whole station's going up — we did it!
Direct hit! Look at that — the sky is ours!
pilot_missed: No good — it didn't go in! Coming around!
Overshot it! Bringing her back for another pass!
mentor_brief: Your training is over, young one. What remains now cannot be taught — only remembered.
mentor_letgo: Let go. The machine cannot see what you feel. Breathe... and trust yourself.
mentor_again: Calm. Center yourself. The port will come to you again.
Do not chase the moment. Let the moment arrive.
mentor_victory: You see now. The strength was always yours — the machine only borrowed it.
mentor_fall: Every fall is a lesson, young one. Rise, and fly again.
The end of one flight is the beginning of the next. Rise.
pilot_droids: Probe machines on the snow — don't let them report in!
There — imperial probes. Burn them down before they call home!
pilot_walkers: Armored walkers on the ridge! Aim for the head — it's the only soft spot!
Walkers! Big, slow, and mean. Head shots, everyone!
pilot_fleet: That's a destroyer up ahead... and everything it owns between us. Punch through!
Whole imperial screen incoming. We carve a path to that dagger!
pilot_fleet_next: The walkers are scrap! Now for their fleet — form on me!
pilot_space2: Their fleet is above the forest moon — clear the sky!
Fighters everywhere. Keep the lanes open for the ground team!
pilot_deck: We're on its hull! Strafe the radars and turrets — strip it bare!
Deck run! Take out every dish and gun you see!
pilot_deck_close: She's listing! A few more hits and she goes down!
pilot_bikes: Speeders in the trees — full throttle! Mind the trunks!
Forest run! These trees come up fast — stay loose!
pilot_generator: The shield bunker — dead ahead! Make this one count!
pilot_shield: The shield is down! The way up is open!
pilot_core: We're inside the superstructure. Tight ducts all the way to the core.
Into the guts of it. Watch the conduits — almost home.
mentor_hoth: Cold tests the flame, young one. Let yours burn steady.
mentor_endor: The forest hides the path, and the path hides the heart. Fly gently, strike surely.
